About us

Your home should reflect your family, taste and budget

Dream Designs Interiors has delivered more than 100 homes and commercial spaces across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Karnataka. We work with National Plywood & Hardware Decor, our materials showroom in Kurnool.

  • One team, start to finishOur designers and site supervisors take every project from the first layout to the final handover.
  • A clear quotationYou know the cost before the work begins.
  • On-time handoverSupervised work, so your home is ready when we said it would be.
